_recipe.title: Tips listicle
_recipe.when: "3 [TOPIC] tips nobody tells you": quick, saveable advice for Instagram / LinkedIn feed (4:5). Coaches, consultants, creators, small brands.
beats: Hook: the count + the topic + the curiosity gap, two kinetic lines.
Tip 1: the tip as a headline (≤ 7 words), the why as a sub line.
Tip 2: do vs don't, as a compare.
Tip 3: on an inverted background, so the strongest tip feels different.
Recap: all three as checks; this is the frame people screenshot.
copyTips: Write each tip as an instruction that starts with a verb ("Post at 7 pm", "Cut the intro").
Keep the strongest tip for #3; it sits on the inverted background and right before the recap.
The recap items should be the 2-4 word short forms of tips 1-3, in the same order.
Mono is Swiss-poster minimal: one red accent, uppercase display. Warmer brands: --theme editorial; playful: --theme pop.
For Reels / Shorts use --format reel; the copy already fits.
